## Analysis overview

Uses ADSL treatment denominators and an empty medication structure because no concomitant-medication ADaM dataset was supplied. The program therefore produces zero medication counts while retaining the intended class/medication summary logic.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `USUBJID`: subject identifier used to link medication exposure to subjects
- `ARM`: randomized treatment arm. CMCLAS and CMDECOD are placeholder medication class and coded-name fields, not sourced from an available ADaM dataset.
